transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in because... well, I just can't make myself go near the front windows at my work anymore, or even that part of the street. I work in retail, and lately I just keep finding excuses to stay in the back room. I know I need to be out on the floor because that's a big part of my job, but I just... I can't go up there right now.
What are you afraid might happen when you go near the front windows or that part of the street?

I don't know if I'm afraid something new is going to happen, it's more that... well, the crash just keeps popping into my head out of nowhere. Especially when I’m up front trying to set up the window displays. 

If I get too close, suddenly I can hear the loud bang again, and I see all the glass coming down. It feels exactly like it’s happening all over again right in front of me. So I just have to stay away from that area.
How long ago did the crash happen?
It was about two weeks ago. I was working an overnight shift, and... well, a car just crashed right through the store window. So this has all been going on since then.
Have these symptoms lasted for one month or longer?
No, it hasn't been a month. Like I mentioned, it's just been about two weeks. It all started right after that car crashed through the window on my overnight shift. So yeah, just the two weeks.
Since the crash, have you had moments when you felt detached from yourself, as if you were observing yourself from outside?

Yeah, actually, I have had moments like that. Sometimes when I'm out on the sales floor, things just feel... off. The lights and the clothing racks seem really far away and fake, almost like a movie set or something. And it feels like I'm just watching myself move through the store, instead of really being there in my own body. It's a really weird feeling.
